primary_estimate: Mean instruction-correct success across three training seeds, plus each seed's individual rate and sample standard deviation
paired_comparison: Fusion minus mono per matched scene and training seed
comparative_interval: 5000 paired crossed bootstrap draws: resample three training seed rows and shared scene columns with replacement; same scene draw across selected rows
reason_for_clarification: Scene IDs are reused across all training seeds. Independently resampling scenes within each seed would discard that crossed dependence. Clarification made before any mono test results or mono/fusion comparative estimate exists, based solely on experimental design.
limitations: Three seeds give limited training-variability estimation. Synthetic scene family is narrow. No frame is an independent experimental unit. Secondary20-scene cells and single-seed ablations exploratory.
ood_drop: Nominal minus OOD on the same subset of paired scenes; use only20 nominal scenes when OOD cell has20
checkpoint_selection: Frozen offline EMA validation criterion; no changes using final test outcomes
